protocol.selection: Every first ordinary directly selected previously unrevealed move of the active opponent at turn-open. Entire games involving Mimic, Metronome, Mirror Move or Transform excluded conservatively. Own-side reconstruction may use full own-set evidence; opponent information uses only the prefix. Reconstruction failures remain reported. Struggle/recharge excluded.
protocol.interpretation: Positive labels only: measures sampled support for newly selected moves, not carry probabilities, precision, calibration, optimality or strength. Existing frozen priors may overlap corpus sources: no out-of-training-sample claim. Unknown never-used moves are not negatives. No tuning or adoption from coverage alone. Compare existing policies as diagnostics; no new policy training.
